verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for email marketing software, since self-hostable alternatives exist in this category, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Benchmark Email offers a self-hosted or on-premises deployment. The API, contact export and hosted signup-form pages are SaaS features adjacent to self-hosting, not self-hosting itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
